To find the root of $f(x),$  we must solve $f(x)=0:$

$$
-{2}^{3x-4}+81=0
$$

First, we isolate the term with the variable exponent by subtracting $81$ from both sides:

$$
\begin{aligned}-{2}^{3x-4}+81 & =0 \\ -{2}^{3x-4}+\cancel{81}-\cancel{81} & =0-81 \\ -{2}^{3x-4} & =-81 \\ {2}^{3x-4} & =81\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we rewrite $81$ as ${3}^{4}$ to get

$$
{2}^{3x-4}={3}^{4}.
$$

Then we take ${log}_{2}$ of both sides of the equation:

$$
\begin{aligned}{2}^{3x-4} & ={3}^{4} \\ {log}_{2}⁡({2}^{3x-4}) & ={log}_{2}⁡({3}^{4}) \\ 3x-4 & =4{log}_{2}⁡(3)\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we solve for $x$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}3x-4 & =4{log}_{2}⁡(3) \\ 3x & =4{log}_{2}⁡(3)+4 \\ x & =\frac{4{log}_{2}⁡(3)+4}{3}\end{aligned}
$$
